titulo: Argentina waves football great Lionel Messi off after 3-0 win over Benin in final international appearance
cuerpo: All-time footballing icon Lionel Messi bids an emotional farewell to international duty after guiding Argentina to a 3-0 win over visitors Benin in Buenos Aires. The little magician produced a final breathtaking performance for his white and blue stripes, scoring one goal and assisting two others.
